correctness.rationale: A regular barycentric orbit CW model is proved, and complete compatible-split and face-chain enumeration yields exact integral boundaries. In the five- and six-leaf cases explicit elementary collapses prove contractibility. In the seven-leaf case Armstrong’s theorem gives π1=0; exact mod-2 and mod-7 boundary ranks imply no lower homology at the primes dividing 14; averaging over other characteristic fields uses the known simply-connected 120-sphere wedge of the original complex. The finite generated integral lower homology thus vanishes. Euler characteristic -12 and Hurewicz–Whitehead give the 13-sphere wedge. A separately implemented signed Burnside trace verifies Euler -12. Mathematical assumptions and finite verification limits are explicit.

value.rationale: Compatible splits give the natural link of phylogenetic tree space; forgetting the orientation and starting leaf of a cyclic arrangement is a canonical dihedral symmetry reduction. The first small orbit spaces change from S0 to contractible to an unexpectedly torsion-free wedge of thirteen 3-spheres. The answer specifies the entire homotopy type and resolves potential 2- and 7-primary quotient torsion rather than just computing a rank or arbitrary minor invariant.
